big_case.notes: A State's emergency application to stay a federal injunction against election-administration guidance (whether checklist supervisors may consider a student ID under New Hampshire's catch-all identity safety valves) weeks before a general election. Statewide effect on student voters and a further data point on how forcefully the Court applies Purcell; but the injunction was narrow (the statute itself was not enjoined), and an interim stay by short order sets little precedent on the merits.
